title: Artificial Intelligence in Logistics: Transforming Supply Chains for Efficiency and Sustainability
description: Artificial intelligence streamlines logistics with route optimization, demand forecasting, and automated warehousing, reducing costs.
short_description: A plain-English guide to AI in Logistics, focused on practical use, trade-offs, and sharper questions.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in Logistics, including operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
